description: This file contains template implementations of clamped mathematical operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, etc.) for integral and floating-point types, with saturation behavior to prevent overflow or underflow. It is part of the 'base' namespace, specifically 'internal', and includes functions for saturated negation and absolute value wrappers, as well as various clamped operation structs.
